title: Temple of Earth
visualBrief: Specific Temple of Earth ceremonial core: two-tier square yellow-brick Fangze altar with pale stone coping/corner dressings, four aligned stairways per tier, square red enclosures with yellow tile coping and open white stone Lingxing gateways, axial approaches and original simplified bronze ritual vessels. Include the mapped southern Huangqi hall court with yellow hipped roofs, red facade, open central doorway, painted beam trim and flanking L-shaped wings. Larger Ditan Park, the distant entrance paifang, gardens and other park compounds remain host context. Internal allocations, terrace/wall heights, gate/vessel inventory and carving are approximate exterior visualization.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact-QID Q615178/way78050667 supplies the132.344x131.955m main ceremonial enclosure; named standard PMTiles point35184450139499 corroborates identity. Root heading0, internal angle+1.474895246492rad, +u approximately south and +v west. Standard native footprints35184749931995/35184756358521/35184756358522 fix the southern Huangqi hall and L-shaped side court. The main altar/enclosure has no native building shell. Its inner wall, terrace dimensions, gateway allocations and vessels are photo-led approximations within the named square. Replace only the three southern matching shells, preserving the other park buildings. Do not treat the whole Ditan Park as one solid building.

Courtyard ground stays open except narrow grade-following approach strips; do not flatten the132m precinct or cut ground/water.
